36100.meaning2: who has struck or killed the mighty being

36101.meaning1: looking around like an elephant; turning the whole body not just the head
36101.commentary: (DNt) nāg'āpalokitan'ti nāgassa viya apalokitaṃ, hatthināgassa apalokanasadisaṃ apalokanan'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesi, na v'āyaṃ dūsī māro mattam'aññāsī'ti. sah'āpalokanāya ca pana, pāpima, dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ'ca upapajji.

36102.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of nāgāpalokita
36102.meaning1: looking around like an elephant; turning the whole body not just the head
36102.commentary: (MNa) nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesī'ti pahārasaddaṃ sutvā yathā nāma hatthināgo ito vā etto vā apaloketu'kāmo gīvaṃ aparivattetvā sakalasarīren'eva nivattitvā apaloketi. evaṃ sakalasarīren'eva nivattitvā apalokesi.

examples.text: atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesi, na v'āyaṃ dūsī māro mattam'aññāsī'ti. sah'āpalokanāya ca pana, pāpima, dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ'ca upapajji.

36103.meaning1: serpent dwelling; home of a nāga

examples.text: ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā, satta devā

36104.meaning1: one hundreds serpent dwellings; one hundred homes of nāgas

examples.text: ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā, satta devā

36105.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; attendant of the Buddha for some time
36105.commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devaloke nibbattitvā apar'āparaṃ puññāni katvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde kapilavatthunagare sakyarājakule nibbatti, nāgito'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. so bhagavati kapilavatthusmiṃ viharante madhupiṇḍikasuttaṃ (ma. ni. 1.199 ādayo) sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne (apa. thera 1.14)
36105.notes: Theragāthā verse 86 (TH1.86, TH86) is attributed to him.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti. atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi, ke pana kho, nāgita, uccāsaddamahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope'ti?

36110.meaning1: ruler of the dragons; nāga lord
36110.meaning2: ruler of the dragons; nāga lord

36112.grammar: pr, from na agghati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: vipassamāno jānāti, ubho bhoge sumedhaso, anavajjasukhass'etaṃ, kalaṃ n'āgghati soḷasin'ti.
ārāmacetyā vanacetyā, pokkharañño sunimmitā, manussarāmaṇeyyassa, kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ.

36113.grammar: pr, from na ācarati, neg, trans (+acc)
36113.meaning1: does not act; does not behave; does not indulge in
36113.construction:
na + ā + cara + ti
na + ācarati

examples.text: dubbhāsitaṃ vikkhalitaṃ, sampamohaṃ parājayaṃ, añño'ññass'ābhinandanti, tadariyo katha'n'ācare.
gacchanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo dakkhiṇen'eva pādena paṭhamaṃ pakkamati. so n'ātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, n'āccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati, so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati
yo n'āccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ accagamā imaṃ papañcaṃ, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

36115.grammar: pr, from na accayati, neg, trans (+acc)
36115.meaning1: (of time) does not pass quickly; does not fly past
36115.construction:
na + ati > aty > acc + aya + ti
na + accayati

examples.text: n'āccayanti ahorattā, jīvitaṃ n'ūparujjhati, āyu anupariyāyati, maccānaṃ nemī'va rathakubbaran'ti.

36116.meaning1: not gone over the limit; who does not overshoot; not overreached

examples.text: yo n'āccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ accagamā imaṃ papañcaṃ, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

36117.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of na accāsanna, neg
36117.meaning1: not too near; not too close-by
36117.construction:
na + ati > aty > acc + āsanna + e
nāccāsanna + e

examples.text: gacchanto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo dakkhiṇen'eva pādena paṭhamaṃ pakkamati. so n'ātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, n'āccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati, so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati
so n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne āsanassa parivattati, na ca pāṇinā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati, na ca āsanasmiṃ kāyaṃ pakkhipati.

36118.grammar: adj, comp, from na uṇha, neg

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.

36119.grammar: adj, comp, from na odāta, neg
36119.meaning1: not too light; not too fair-skinned

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khattiyakaññā vā brāhmaṇakaññā vā gahapatikaññā vā pannarasavass'uddesikā vā soḷasavass'uddesikā vā, n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā paramā sā, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye subhā vaṇṇanibhā'ti?

36120.meaning1: not from problems with livelihood; not from having difficulty earning a living
36120.meaning2: not having difficulty earning a living
36120.commentary: (MNa) dubbhikkh'ādīsu jīvituṃ asakkonto pabbajito ājīvik'āpakato nāma, ājīvikāya pakato abhibhūto'ti attho. (SNa) ājīvik'āpakatā'ti ājīvikāya upaddutā abhibhūtā, puttadāraṃ posetuṃ asakkontā'ti attho.
36120.notes: The commentary suggests pakata , but apakata 'done wrongly' makes more contextual sense.

examples.text: te ca kho pana tumhe, anuruddhā, n'eva rāj'ābhinītā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, na cor'ābhinītā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, na iṇ'aṭṭā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, na bhay'aṭṭā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, n'ājīvik'āpakatā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā.

36121.grammar: imperf of na adhigacchati, neg, trans (+acc)
36121.meaning1: did not discover; did not find
36121.construction: na + adhi > adhy > ajjh + a + √gam + ā
36121.commentary: (SNa) n'ājjhagamun'ti na adhigacchanti na vindanti na passanti. vattamān'atthe atītavacanaṃ.

examples.text: yo n'ājjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ, vicinaṃ puppham'iva udumbaresu, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
pahāsi saṅkhaṃ na vimānam'ajjhagā, acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe, taṃ chinnaganthaṃ anighaṃ nirāsaṃ, pariyesamānā n'ājjhagamuṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā sabbanivesanesu.

36122.grammar: imperf of na adhigacchati, neg, trans (+acc)
36122.meaning1: did not attain; did not obtain
36122.construction: na + adhi > adhy > ajjh + a + √gam + ā

examples.text: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ hoti, so ca aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ n'ājjhagamaṃ, aññaṃ vā tato santataraṃ, atha khv'āhaṃ n'eva tāva anāvaṭṭī kāmesu paccaññāsiṃ.

tāya'pi kho tvaṃ, āvuso gotama, iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya n'ājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ, kiṃ pana tvaṃ eta'r'ahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesan'ti?

36123.grammar: imperf of na adhigacchati, neg, trans (+acc)
36123.meaning1: did not get; did not obtain; did not find; (comm) did not see
36123.meaning2: did not get; did not obtain
36123.construction: na + adhi > adhy > ajjh + a + √gam + ā

examples.text: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, yato yāva brahmalokā pariyesamāno imassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ n'ājjhagā, atha mamaññ'eva santike paccāgato.
evaṃ virattaṃ khem'attaṃ, sabbasaṃyojan'ātigaṃ, anvesaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu, mārasenā'pi n'ājjhagā'ti.

36124.grammar: pr, from na ajjheti, neg, intrans
36124.meaning1: does not fret; does not worry; is not anxious
36124.construction:
na + ā + jhe + ti
na + ajjheti

examples.text: yo'dha kāme accatari, saṅgaṃ loke duraccayaṃ, na so socati n'ājjheti, chinnasoto abandhano.

36125.grammar: ger of na ajjhosati, neg, trans (+acc)
36125.meaning1: not clinging; not fixating; not obsessing; not holding tightly
36125.construction:
na + adhi + ava + √sā + ya
na + ajjhosaya > nājjhosa

examples.text: na so rajjati rūpesu, rūpaṃ disvā paṭissato, virattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca n'ājjhosa tiṭṭhati.

36126.grammar: ger of na ajjhosati, neg, trans (+acc)
36126.meaning1: not clinging; not fixating; not obsessing; not holding tightly
36126.construction:
na + adhi + ava + √sā + ya
na + ajjhosāya

examples.text: rasañ'ca bhotvāna asāditañ'ca sāduṃ, atho'pi bhotvāna asādum'ekadā, sāduṃ rasaṃ n'ājjhosāya bhuñje, virodham'āsādusu n'opadaṃsaye.
tañ'ce bhikkhu n'ābhinandati n'ābhivadati n'ājjhosāya tiṭṭhati, tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nirujjhati nandī. nandinirodhā dukkhanirodho, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi

36127.meaning1: not another; not different; not someone else; not somewhere else

examples.text: attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attanā saṃkilissati, attanā akataṃ pāpaṃ, attanā'va visujjhati, suddhī asuddhi paccattaṃ, n'āñño aññaṃ visodhaye.
idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
dukkham'eva hi sambhoti, dukkhaṃ tiṭṭhati veti ca, n'āññatra dukkhā sambhoti, n'āññaṃ dukkhā nirujjhatī'ti.

so vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānam'etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ n'āññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya, aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukarissati, tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdissati, seyyathā'pi sarabho paribbājako.

36130.grammar: pron, abl sg of nāñña, neg
36130.meaning1: from no-one else; from no other (person)
36130.commentary: (SNa) n'āññato'ti vālik'ādīhi tel'ādīni viya aññato andhabālato paññā nāma na labbhati, til'ādīhi pana tel'ādīni viya sataṃ dhammaṃ ñatvā paṇḍitam'eva sevanto bhajanto labhatī'ti.

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, paññā labbhati n'āññato'ti.

36131.grammar: ind, prep, from na añña, neg (+abl)
36131.meaning1: nothing aside (from); nothing apart (from); nothing other (than); nothing except (for)

examples.text: dukkham'eva hi sambhoti, dukkhaṃ tiṭṭhati veti ca, n'āññatra dukkhā sambhoti, n'āññaṃ dukkhā nirujjhatī'ti.
na aññatra bhagavatā, n'āññatra tava sāsanā, yassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanaṃ.

36132.grammar: nt, abstr, from na aññathā, neg (+gen)
36132.construction:
na + añña + thā + tta
nāññathā + tta

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhonto, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ etadavocaṃ, kiñ'hi me, bhante, indriyānaṃ n'āññathattaṃ bhavissati, mayhañ'hi, bhante, ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālaṅ'kato. tassa kālaṃkiriyāya n'eva kamm'antā paṭibhanti, na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti.

idha pana, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu abhiṇh'āpattiko hoti āpattibahulo. so bhikkhūhi vuccamāno n'āññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ na apanāmeti, na kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, sammā vattati, lomaṃ pāteti, netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti āha.
atha kho nīko devaputto nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
dāsidāse gavasse ca, bhatake nāṭake bahū, nhāpite bhattake sūde, sabbatth'eva labhām'ahaṃ.

36139.commentary: (DNa) tassa ca nagarā ahu antalikkhe sumāpitā'ti tassa rañño ākāse suṭṭhu māpitā ete āṭānāṭ'ādikā nagarā ahesuṃ, nagarāni bhaviṃsū'ti attho. ekañ'hi'ssa nagaraṃ āṭānāṭā nāma āsi, ekaṃ kusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ parakusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ nāṭasūriyā nāma, ekaṃ parakusiṭanāṭā nāma.

examples.text: tassa ca nagarā ahu, antalikkhe sumāpitā, āṭānāṭā kusināṭā parakusināṭā, nāṭapariyā parakusiṭanāṭā.

36140.meaning1: family name of Mahavira; leader of the Jains

examples.text: atha kho nīko devaputto nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
ayam'pi kho nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto saṅghī c'eva gaṇī ca gaṇ'ācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
vadho'y'eva kho maññe nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu vattati.

36142.commentary: (DNa) tassa ca nagarā ahu antalikkhe sumāpitā'ti tassa rañño ākāse suṭṭhu māpitā ete āṭānāṭ'ādikā nagarā ahesuṃ, nagarāni bhaviṃsū'ti attho. ekañ'hi'ssa nagaraṃ āṭānāṭā nāma āsi, ekaṃ kusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ parakusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ nāṭasūriyā nāma, ekaṃ parakusiṭanāṭā nāma.

examples.text: tassa ca nagarā ahu, antalikkhe sumāpitā, āṭānāṭā kusināṭā parakusināṭā, nāṭapuriyā parakusiṭanāṭā.

36143.commentary: (DNa) tassa ca nagarā ahu antalikkhe sumāpitā'ti tassa rañño ākāse suṭṭhu māpitā ete āṭānāṭ'ādikā nagarā ahesuṃ, nagarāni bhaviṃsū'ti attho. ekañ'hi'ssa nagaraṃ āṭānāṭā nāma āsi, ekaṃ kusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ parakusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ nāṭasūriyā nāma, ekaṃ parakusiṭanāṭā nāma.

examples.text: tassa ca nagarā ahu, antalikkhe sumāpitā, āṭānāṭā kusināṭā parakusināṭā, nāṭasuriyā parakusiṭanāṭā.
idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ'y'eva appamattakaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, n'āṇu'pi khāyati, kiṃ bahu'd'eva.

36148.meaning1: family name of Mahavira, leader of the Jains

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārik'ambavane. tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nātaputto nāḷandāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ.

36150.grammar: adj, comp, from na ucca, neg
36150.meaning1: not very high; not extremely lofty; not too tall

36151.commentary: (MNa) nātike viharatī'ti nātikā nāma ekaṃ taḷākaṃ nissāya dvinnaṃ cūḷapitimahāpitiputtānaṃ dve gāmā, tesu ekasmiṃ gāme. (ANa) nātike'ti evaṃnāmake gāme.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. atha kho āyasmā saddho yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.

36152.grammar: pr, from na atikaḍḍhati, neg, intrans
36152.meaning1: does not over-react; does not get angry
36152.construction:
na + ati + kaḍḍha + ti
na + atikaḍḍhati
36152.commentary: (VINa) n'ātikaḍḍheyyāsī'ti yaṃ te mayi pemaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, taṃ kodhavasena na atikaḍḍheyyāsi, sace na kujjheyyāsī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

36153.meaning1: not too dark; not too black

examples.text: hīnaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ, atidīghaṃ, atirassaṃ, atikaṇhaṃ, accodātaṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ. ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ, nātidīghaṃ, nātirassaṃ, nātikaṇhaṃ, nāccodātaṃ.

36155.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of na atikāla, neg
36155.meaning1: not too early; not very early in the morning
36155.construction:
na + ati + kāla + ena
nātikāla + ena
36155.commentary: (MNa) n'ātikālenā'ti na atipāto pavisitabbaṃ, na atidivā paṭikkamitabbaṃ, bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ'y'eva pavisitabbañ'ca nikkhamitabbañ'ca. atipāto pavisitvā atidivā nikkhamantassa hi cetiy'aṅgaṇa-bodhiy'aṅgaṇa-vatt'ādīni parihāyanti. kālass'eva mukhaṃ dhovitvā makkaṭakasuttāni chindantena ussāvabindū nipātentena gāmaṃ pavisitvā yāguṃ pariyesitvā yāva bhikkhākālā antogāme'y'eva nānappakāraṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentena nisīditvā bhattakiccaṃ katvā divā nikkhamma bhikkhūnaṃ pādadhovanavelāya vihāraṃ paccāgantabbaṃ hoti.

examples.text: āraññiken'āvuso, bhikkhunā saṅghagatena saṅghe viharantena n'ātikālena gāmo pavisitabbo n'ātidivā paṭikkamitabbaṃ.

36156.meaning1: not too black; not too dark-skinned
36156.meaning2: not too black; not too dark-skinned
36156.construction:
na + ati + kāḷa + ika
nātikāḷa + ika

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa itthiratanaṃ pāturahosi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷikā n'āccodātā atikkantā mānusivaṇṇaṃ appattā dibbavaṇṇaṃ.

36157.meaning1: not too black; not too dark-skinned
36157.construction:
na + ati + kāḷa + ī
nātikāḷa + ī
36157.commentary: (SNt) n'ātikāḷā n'āccodātā'ti ativiya kāḷavaṇṇā jhām'aṅgāro viya, dadhitakk'ādīhi pamajjitamattakaṃsalohavaṇṇā na hoti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khattiyakaññā vā brāhmaṇakaññā vā gahapatikaññā vā pannarasavass'uddesikā vā soḷasavass'uddesikā vā, n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā paramā sā, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye subhā vaṇṇanibhā'ti?

36168.commentary: (MNa) n'ātikālenā'ti na atipāto pavisitabbaṃ, na atidivā paṭikkamitabbaṃ, bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ'y'eva pavisitabbañ'ca nikkhamitabbañ'ca. atipāto pavisitvā atidivā nikkhamantassa hi cetiy'aṅgaṇa-bodhiy'aṅgaṇa-vatt'ādīni parihāyanti. kālass'eva mukhaṃ dhovitvā makkaṭakasuttāni chindantena ussāvabindū nipātentena gāmaṃ pavisitvā yāguṃ pariyesitvā yāva bhikkhākālā antogāme'y'eva nānappakāraṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentena nisīditvā bhattakiccaṃ katvā divā nikkhamma bhikkhūnaṃ pādadhovanavelāya vihāraṃ paccāgantabbaṃ hoti.

examples.text: āraññiken'āvuso, bhikkhunā saṅghagatena saṅghe viharantena n'ātikālena gāmo pavisitabbo n'ātidivā paṭikkamitabbaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khattiyakaññā vā brāhmaṇakaññā vā gahapatikaññā vā pannarasavass'uddesikā vā soḷasavass'uddesikā vā, n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā paramā sā, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye subhā vaṇṇanibhā'ti?

so n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne āsanassa parivattati, na ca pāṇinā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati, na ca āsanasmiṃ kāyaṃ pakkhipati.

36176.grammar: pr, from na atimaññati, neg, trans (+acc)
36176.meaning1: does not despise; does not scorn; does not look down (on); does not have contempt (for); is not condescending (towards)
36176.construction:

na + atimaññati
36176.commentary: (DHPa) salābhaṃ nātimaññatī'ti appalābho'pi samāno uccanīcakule paṭipāṭiyā sapadānaṃ caranto bhikkhu salābhaṃ n'ātimaññati nāma.

examples.text: na paro paraṃ nikubbetha, n'ātimaññetha katthaci naṃ kañci, byārosanā paṭighasaññā, n'āññam'aññassa dukkham'iccheyya.
appalābho'pi ce bhikkhu, salābhaṃ n'ātimaññati, taṃ ve devā pasaṃsanti, suddhājīviṃ atanditaṃ.

36178.meaning1: should not be underestimated; should not be undervalued (towards)
36178.meaningLit: not to be thought in excess
36178.commentary: (MNa) upekkhā n'ātimaññitabbā'ti upekkhā na atikkamitabbā, kattabbā janetabbā'ti attho. yo hi evarūpaṃ puggalaṃ ṭhitakaṃ'y'eva passāvaṃ karontaṃ disvā'pi nanu, āvuso, nisīditabban'ti vadati, so upekkhaṃ atimaññati nāma.

examples.text: paro hi puggalo kodhano upanāhī daḷhadiṭṭhī duppaṭinissaggī, na c'āhaṃ sakkomi etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun'ti. evarūpe, bhikkhave, puggale upekkhā n'ātimaññitabbā.

36179.commentary: (VINa) n'ātimahanto kabaḷo'ti mayūr'aṇḍaṃ atimahantaṃ, kukkuṭ'aṇḍaṃ atikhuddakaṃ, tesaṃ vemajjhappamāṇo.

examples.text: n'ātimahantaṃ kabaḷaṃ karissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
n'ātimahanto kabaḷo kātabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca mahantaṃ kabaḷaṃ karoti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khattiyakaññā vā brāhmaṇakaññā vā gahapatikaññā vā pannarasavass'uddesikā vā soḷasavass'uddesikā vā, n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā paramā sā, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye subhā vaṇṇanibhā'ti?

examples.text: so n'ātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, n'āccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati, so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca adduvena adduvaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati.
so taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamati. so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca muccitu'kāmo gacchati.

36182.meaning1: not too loose; not too slack; not too flat

examples.text: yadā pana te, soṇa, vīṇāya tantiyo na accāyatā honti n'ātisithilā same guṇe patiṭṭhitā, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

36183.commentary: (MNa) n'ātisīghan'ti divā vihārabhatt'atthāya gacchanto bhikkhu viya na atisīghaṃ gacchati.

so taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamati. so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca muccitu'kāmo gacchati.

36184.grammar: adj, comp, from na sīta, neg

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.
so, n'ātisupakko maccho mayhaṃ aphāsukam'akāsi, bhante'ti. āvuso, tuyhaṃ phāsukena vā aphāsukena vā kammaṃ n'atthi, āpattiṃ āpanno'sī'ti. bhante, yāva tattha vasiṃ, tāva me aphāsukam'eva jātan'ti.

anissito na calati, nissito ca upādiyaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.

nātivelā + aṃ

examples.text: cudito vacībhi satim'ābhinande, sabrahmacārīsu khilaṃ pabhinde, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ n'ātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya.

36191.meaning1: not devoted to the practice of harming oneself; not dedicated to self-mortification

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo n'ev'attan'tapo hoti n'āttaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto na paran'tapo na paraparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto?
yo ca kho ayaṃ, bhante, puggalo n'ev'attan'tapo n'āttaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto na paran'tapo na paraparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto… ayam'eva me puggalo cittaṃ ārādhetī'ti.

36192.commentary: (DHPa) nātho'ti avassayo patiṭṭhā. ko hi nātho paro'ti yasmā parassa attabhāve patiṭṭhāya kusalaṃ vā katvā saggaparāyaṇena maggaṃ vā bhāvetvā sacchikataphalena bhavituṃ na sakkā, tasmā ko hi nāma paro nātho bhaveyyā'ti attho. (DHPa) nātho'ti patiṭṭhā. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yasmā attani ṭhitena attasampannena kusalaṃ katvā saggaṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ, maggaṃ vā bhāvetuṃ, phalaṃ vā sacchikātuṃ sakkā. tasmā hi attā'va attano patiṭṭhā hoti, paro ko nāma kassa patiṭṭhā siyā.

examples.text: attā hi attano nātho, ko hi nātho paro siyā, attanā hi sudantena, nāthaṃ labhati dullabhaṃ.
vandanaṃ dāni vajjāsi, lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ, padakkhiṇañ'ca katvāna, ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇaṃ.

36193.meaning1: providing protection; serving as a refuge
36193.meaning2: producing a support, making for protection
36193.commentary: (DNa) nāthakaraṇā'ti sanāthā, bhikkhave, viharatha mā anāthā, dasa ime, bhikkhave, dhammā nāthakaraṇā'ti (a. ni. 10.18) evaṃ akkhātā attano patiṭṭhākarā dhammā. (DNt) yehi sīl'ādīhi samannāgato bhikkhu dhammasaraṇatāya dhammen'eva nāthati īsati abhibhavatī'ti nātho'ti vuccati, te tassa nāthabhāvakarā dhammā nāthakaraṇā'ti vuttā'ti āha sanāthā… patiṭṭhākarā dhammā'ti.

examples.text: yaṃ'p'āvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. ayam'pi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.

36194.meaning1: things which serve as protectors; matters which provide refuge
36194.commentary: (DNa) nāthakaraṇā'ti sanāthā, bhikkhave, viharatha mā anāthā, dasa ime, bhikkhave, dhammā nāthakaraṇā'ti (a. ni. 10.18) evaṃ akkhātā attano patiṭṭhākarā dhammā.

examples.text: katame dasa dhammā bahukārā? dasa nāthakaraṇādhammā, idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu

36195.meaning1: family name of Mahavira; leader of the Jains

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāthaputto nāḷandāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ.

36197.meaning1: rich and poor; powerful and poor; mighty and helpless

examples.text: ev'āhaṃ cintayitvāna, n'ekakoṭisataṃ dhanaṃ, nāth'ānāthānaṃ datvāna, himavantam'upāgamiṃ.
dasabalasamannāgato, bhikkhave, tathāgato catūhi ca vesārajjehi samannāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti
atha kiñ'carahi ty'āyaṃ, sāriputta, uḷārā āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ek'aṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito

36199.meaning1: should not be taken; should not be stolen

examples.text: rājā cakkavattī evam'āha, pāṇo na hantabbo, adinnaṃ n'ādātabbaṃ, kāmesumicchā na caritabbā, musā na bhāsitabbā, majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ, yathābhuttañ'ca bhuñjathā'ti. ye kho pana, bhikkhave, puratthimāya disāya paṭirājāno, te rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā ahesuṃ.
